blockers.rootCause: Browser switch availability is checked only at admission/settlement; OFF history is not latched. onRemoved handles only origins; runner recheck explicitly writes fence. Current true state cannot prove uninterrupted authorization.
requiredRepair: Implement and prove an operation-owned browser-backed revocation/incarnation invalidation path; do not rely on runner recheck or move its effect into a passive observer.

Keep granted-again operations separate from old pending operations. Real UI OFF/ON must prevent acceptance of old native-completed and pending outcomes in both worlds/versions, with no test-injected fence.

If browser provides no reliable history signal for a transient change, record the limitation and keep this contract blocked; periodic checks alone cannot prove every OFF/ON interval. Do not silently narrow the contract.

controlOracleAdvisory.finalVerdict: not issued; control not frozen; supplemental only
controlOracleAdvisory.conditionalInterpretation: The approved Worker gone/CPU execution stopped language permits independent proof of actual execution cessation within 2s; delayed CDP descriptor metadata need not be equated with live execution. This is an evidentiary distinction only, not permission to relax 2s or rewrite expectations. Exact Worker-associated execution evidence is mandatory.
reasons: Highest renderer cumulative CPU delta is not a mapping from the exact private run/Blob target to an OS process/thread. Fresh profile still has multiple renderer processes and other runnable JS.
busyRenderer.delta>0.1 provides activity correlation, not causal ownership; SystemInfo processInfo has PID/type/cpuTime but no Worker target identity.
Missing pre/stop/early samples are mapped to zero. Zero cannot stand for observed cessation unless the same bound process/thread is independently confirmed dead.
A single low-CPU 150ms interval can reflect scheduling/starvation; final target disappearance alone cannot establish it was stopped by the deadline.
settledAt is emitted after admission closes and stop is posted; it is a trigger proxy, not termination-done. Delayed observer retrieval/realm recreation cannot reset the 2s clock.
requiredEvidence: Native runId/name/Blob URL, correct extension/host parent/epoch and unique target identification, with no attached Worker debugger during infinite loop.
Independent target-to-renderer/thread association, or explicitly exclusive renderer execution proven before loop start; no unbound highest-delta shortcut.
Observe loop entered plus sustained bound native CPU activity before stop; record stop admission-close/stopSentAt or due/fired deadline/host-close request with a common calibrated monotonic clock.

Timestamp CPU sample request and response bounds; observe sustained bound execution cessation by trigger+2s, plus true process/thread exit or target destruction/absence. Missing samples must be unknown unless confirmed lifecycle exit; sampling intervals crossing the deadline cannot be used as within-deadline proof.
Retain sustained post-stop observations, host responsiveness and no late page operations; separate native Worker stop, owned realm retirement, CPU cessation and CDP descriptor disposal.
Preserve old FAIL. No backend/permission change or contract amendment without authorized review.
